mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent economic indicators of contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drop does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected cut in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances following a Fed rate cut, or the rate cut does not correlate with subsequent easing actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint movement of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent housing market strength.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals increased borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.
